name: Samson
overview: The story of Samson begins in Judges 13, where Israel again falls into sin and is oppressed by the Philistines. God intervenes by announcing the birth of a deliverer to a barren woman from the Danite family, Manoah's wife, who is instructed to live under Nazarite vows even before birth—abstaining from wine, strong drink, and unclean foods. This miraculous birth and divine calling set the stage for Samson's role as a judge who will begin to rescue Israel from Philistine domination.
